headline: Team USA scores 108 in rout of Hungary to reach FIBA semis
description: The U.S. routed Hungary 108-56 to advance to the semifinals of the women's FIBA World Cup and stretched its winning streak in the tournament to 34 games.

headline: Nigeria 'weren't there yet' after FIBA Women's World Cup exit - Rena Wakama
description: The Nigerian women ended their campaign with a 111-56 loss to France on Monday, their third defeat in as many Group B games after opening with a 99-81 loss to South Korea and then falling 71-67 to Hungary.

headline: Angel Reese, Caitlin Clark having 'fun' playing together for U.S.
description: Angel Reese and Caitlin Clark's interactions are a subplot of the women's FIBA World Cup and the WNBA season, but Clark says many of the stories about their relationship are "false takes," saying she loves the fiery competitiveness that they share.

headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: Team USA and quarterfinal preview
description: The U.S. women and France remain front-runners as the knockout stage arrives in Berlin, but who else has impressed?

headline: USA eyes more consistency vs. Hungary at FIBA World Cup
description: USA coach Kara Lawson is hoping her team can improve with each round of the FIBA World Cup, beginning with Thursday's quarterfinal game vs. Hungary.

headline: WNBA  playoffs schedule 2026: Dates released for postseason
description: The first round of the 2026 WNBA playoffs opens on Sept. 27. The semifinals tip Oct. 4 and the Finals open Oct. 17.

headline: Germany beats South Korea, rolls into World Cup quarterfinals
description: Host Germany advanced to the quarterfinals of the women's FIBA World Cup with a morale-boosting 94-56 rout of South Korea on Tuesday, and the United States learned its next opponent.

headline: Potential WNBA commissioner candidates to succeed Cathy Engelbert
description: Executives from the WNBA, NBA and Nike are among potential candidates to succeed Cathy Engelbert when she retires.

headline: Arena for 76ers, Flyers to open in 2030, marks 'new era'
description: The 76ers and Flyers have unveiled renderings of their new fully privately funded arena in South Philadelphia, which is targeted to open before the WNBA season in 2030.

headline: U.S. closes pool play with 105-64 rout of Czechia
description: The United States routed Czechia 105-64 to close out pool play at the FIBA World Cup and rebound from a tough performance against Italy.

headline: WNBA offseason 2026: Guides for every eliminated team
description: With 2026 playoff teams decided, we break down the priorities and needs for each eliminated WNBA team.

headline: Belgium's Julie Allemand breaks World Cup assist record in win
description: Julie Allemand broke Spain's Laia Palau's mark of 108 assists in the first half of Belgium's 80-68 win over Australia that clinched a spot in the quarterfinals. She now has 111 in her World Cup career.

headline: Team USA escapes with win over Italy at women's FIBA World Cup
description: Team USA survived its toughest test in the women's basketball World Cup in two decades with a 55-52 victory over Italy on Sunday in Berlin, pushing its winning streak in World Cup play to 32 games.

headline: Mali shocks Spain at FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup
description: Mali pulled off the first stunner of the Women's Basketball World Cup by shocking Spain 82-73.

headline: Sparks hiring Sixers executive Andonian as general manager
description: The Sparks, who will miss the playoffs for the sixth straight season, have hired Ariana Andonian as general manager.

headline: What WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert's retirement means
description: What does the league need from its next commissioner after Cathy Engelbert retires? Is the WNBA better off now than when she took over?

headline: Sky owner calls Kanter Freedom's free speech lawsuit 'meritless'
description: Chicago Sky owner Michael Alter called a lawsuit filed by Enes Kanter Freedom "meritless and frivolous."

headline: Cathy Engelbert, who oversaw WNBA boom, to retire as commissioner
description: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert, who oversaw massive growth in the league while also facing recent scrutiny in her handling of multiple issues, will retire at the end of the year.
